# Local Dream usability cases

Six assertion-backed cases: four root routes and two difficult integrations. These are inspection rubrics, not evidence of a live model/agent trial. All major selected routes have assertions. ModelStorageTest and ExampleUnitTest are preserved as source-definition candidates in the review report, not adapted as proof of lifecycle or diffusion behavior. No upstream test provides the cross-boundary scenarios, so both integration cases are explicitly synthetic.

| Case | Capability | Difficulty | Evidence class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `root/ordinary-reentry` | lifecycle | intermediate | source-informed synthetic |
| `root/same-model-wrong-bind` | lifecycle | troubleshooting | source-informed synthetic |
| `root/cache-after-model-change` | cache | troubleshooting | source-informed synthetic |
| `root/dsp-library-packaging` | packaging | advanced | source-informed synthetic |
| `integration/remote-cancel-switch` | integrated | troubleshooting | source-informed synthetic |
| `integration/declaration-is-not-native` | integrated | advanced | source-informed synthetic |

Coverage: route discovery, exact-config helper execution, packaging support, cache invalidation, cancellation/host troubleshooting and evidence/rights boundaries. No subskills exist; the three deep references are routes within one boundary audit. Six assertion manifests; all source paths are in the source ledger. No weights, native fixtures or secrets. Future agent efficacy grading and original/native execution remain not_run.
